art_style: Flat vector art with soft gradients
setting: A grassy meadow with floating platforms
game_mechanics: Hop left/right across platforms in 2D space.
Avoid gaps—falling resets to last platform.
Collect an apple sprite for +1 point and play sparkle effect.
Landing resets jump ability once per platform.
